title: SignalEnvelope
description: Graded stream item for politic.bar / weak-signal ingress with memetic half-life metrics (Phase A contract)

stream_item_id.description: Stable identifier for this stream item within the ingest store

story_id.description: Stable story anchor (politic.bar stream ID or cross-layer story_id)

evidence_grade.description: Adapter-mapped evidence strength — not a legal or moral verdict

memetic_metrics.description: Optional propagation / decay metrics for narrative velocity modeling

first_seen.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the item first entered the stream index

peak_velocity.description: Estimated peak repost/share rate (items per hour) at observation time

decay_tau_hours.description: Estimated exponential decay time constant in hours

variant_of.description: Parent stream_item_id when this item is a narrative or media variant

platform_contour.description: SOCIAL_MEDIA platform slug or contour label (taxonomy reference only — no new mode IDs)

epistemic_label.description: Default OPERATIONAL for adapter-derived stream items

stream_refs.description: Optional upstream record IDs (Exa, RSS, adapter records)

testament_clause_ref.description: Optional POSLEDNIY_ZAVET clause sidecar (I–X). Propagates to half-life cross-layer metadata.

persona_cohort_id.description: Optional MatrAIx persona cohort slug for stream-item diversity conditioning (sidecar only). Not a citizen identity.
